description_en: Deletes a component from a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live delete-caster-component --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --component-id 21926b36-7dd2-4fde-ae25-51b5bc8e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCasterComponent

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, find the ID on the Cloud Production Studio page. In the ApsaraVideo Live console, choose Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The component ID. If you add a component to the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848030.html operation, use the ComponentId value that is returned in the response
parameters.help_zh: 组件ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848030.html添加导播台组件，请查看AddCasterComponent接口调用返回的参数ComponentId值
parameters.name: component_id

CasterId.description_en: The ID of the production studio. This ID can be used in subsequent API calls to query the component list, add a program, or modify a component of the production studio
CasterId.description_zh: 导播台ID。可作为查询导播台组件列表、添加导播台节目单、修改导播台组件的请求参数

ComponentId.description_en: The component ID. This ID can be used in subsequent API calls to query or modify the component
ComponentId.description_zh: 组件ID。可作为查询导播台组件列表、修改导播台组件的请求参数
